description: Directional traffic count locations is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. ​This dataset contains the locations of automated counters where directional traffic volume data was collected between 2004 to 2013. Note The counts are available for viewing only in Legacy VanMap. Data currency ​This is a static dataset. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. The portal shows 6,680 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
